system.description:
• Effect: Permanent passive aura — +2 AC and +2 on all saves against evil creatures. Summoned and conjured evil creatures cannot make physical contact with the Paladin; their natural weapon attacks fail and they recoil.
  • Good elementals and outsiders are immune to this effect
  • Immune to all diseases of any origin.
  • Detect Evil: concentrate for one round while facing a target within 60ft — innate ability, no spellcasting involved. Usable as often as desired.
  • Aura of Courage (6th level): immune to fear (magical or otherwise). Allies within the aura's range gain +4 on saves vs fear — see the Paladin Progression Table (10ft at 6th, 30ft at 15th, 50ft at 20th).

activities.name: Detect Evil
activities.text: Concentrate for one round while facing a target within 60ft to detect evil.

rules.value: Divine Protection: immune to all diseases.
